name: price-saas-subscription
job: Price a SaaS subscription: packaging, meters, fences, migration, with internally consistent pricing arithmetic.

inScope: Identifying buyer, value metric, cost driver, and expansion path
Designing packaging, plan boundaries, and upgrade moments
Running pricing arithmetic and unit-economics sanity checks
Defining bounded validation, sales enablement, and kill criteria
outOfScope: Approved price-increase migration cohorts without a separate artifact

inputs: Customer, buyer, purchasing motion, and value metric
Cost, margin, usage, conversion, churn, and support data
outputs: Pricing and Packaging Decision with plan architecture
Pricing arithmetic pass with margin sanity check
Experiment or rollout plan with guardrails and kill criteria

data: current internal cost, margin, usage, conversion, and churn data

failureSemantics: Seat minimums versus included seats, overage rates versus marginal cost, and annual terms must reconcile; missing values are marked assumptions and the recommendation becomes a bounded experiment, never hidden policy.

outcome.observable: A Pricing and Packaging Decision with an internally consistent arithmetic pass, named value metric and plan boundaries, margin guardrails, and a bounded rollout plan with kill criteria.
